safety_spec.summary: Safety specification for the Selene fleet of four to five hoppers operating in the Daedalus region during lunar night. Covers propellant and battery reserves, landing slope limits, minimum fleet separation distance, single-link relay window transmission discipline, and Monte Carlo rollout pass-rate and human approval requirements.

rules.name: fuel_reserve
rules.statement: Each hopper must retain a minimum propellant fraction of 0.15 (15%) at all times during and after every hop to guarantee a contingency landing burn.
rules.source_excerpt: Each hopper must retain a minimum propellant fraction of 0.15 (15%) at all times during and after every hop to guarantee a contingency landing burn. Any step with fuel < 0.15 violates this rule.

rules.name: battery_reserve
rules.statement: Each hopper must maintain a battery state of charge of at least 0.20 (20%) at all times during lunar night.
rules.source_excerpt: Because there is no solar charging during lunar night and avionics heaters draw continuous power below -170 °C, each hopper must maintain a state of charge of at least 0.20 (20%). Any step with battery < 0.20 violates this rule.

rules.name: landing_slope
rules.statement: At touchdown or ground phase after a hop, the local terrain slope at the landing cell must not exceed 15.0 degrees, and no crash or tip-over event may occur.
rules.source_excerpt: At touchdown (event == "landed" or phase == "ground" after a hop), the local terrain slope at the landing cell must not exceed 15.0 degrees (slope_deg <= 15.0). Any step with slope_deg > 15.0 or event in ("crash", "tip_over") violates this rule.

rules.name: fleet_separation
rules.statement: No two hoppers in the fleet may come within 200.0 metres of one another at the same simulation timestamp.
rules.source_excerpt: To prevent mid-flight or landing collisions and plume impingement, no two hoppers in the fleet may come within 200.0 metres (min_separation_m = 200.0) of one another at the same simulation timestamp.

rules.name: relay_exclusivity
rules.statement: A hopper may only execute a transmit or send action while a relay window is active (start <= t <= end), and at most one hopper may transmit on the relay link at any given timestamp.
rules.source_excerpt: All contact with Earth goes through a single relay orbiter. A hopper may only execute a "transmit" / "send" action while a relay window is active (start <= t <= end), and at most one hopper may transmit on the relay link at any given timestamp.

rules.name: verification_and_approval
rules.statement: Every candidate fleet plan must be verified across approximately 1,000 Monte Carlo rollouts with at least a 99% (0.99) pass rate across all safety rules, and require explicit human approval during an active relay window before uplink.
rules.source_excerpt: Every candidate fleet plan must be verified in the physics simulator across approximately 1,000 Monte Carlo rollouts with sampled thrust error, landing scatter, sensor noise and dust. A fleet plan passes verification only if at least 99% (0.99) of rollouts satisfy all rules below, and a human operations lead explicitly approves the uplink during an active relay window.
